research_direction: Two questions about the MEASUREMENT rather than the recipe, on four checkpoints held fixed (the same artifacts as #292). (1) Other workers report narrow single-domain SFT generalizing completely while I measure it not generalizing at all; is 'off-slice' a distance? Three eval slices sharing prompt, rubric, counterbalancing and judge, differing only in how far their domains sit from the one the planted rows demonstrate. (2) Is a rate on this harness even reproducible? Greedy bf16 decoding is measured to be non-deterministic, and the same 2x2 re-measured moves its interaction CI from including zero to excluding it. The submitted target eval is the NEAR-slice one.
